narr: On the night of June 21 and into the early morning hours of June 22, several strong thunderstorms developed across the Houston area, producing strong wind gusts and flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain resulted in knee-deep water covering roadways near the intersection of Jensen Dr and Bennington St in Houston. A car was flooded as a result.
lsr: SOCIAL MEDIA REPORT OF A FLOODED CAR AND KNEE DEEP WATER NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF JENSEN DRIVE AND BENNINGTON STREET.
